records.context: Microscope field of view quality control and confounder adjustment for image-based readouts.
records.label: spacr.recruitment_confounders#0
records.source: Field quality control and confounder adjustment for image-based readouts.
records.translation: 针对基于图像的读出值的视野质量控制和混杂因素校正。

records.context: A recruitment ratio (or a vacuole size) measured per object is not only a function of the condition in the microplate sample position. It also moves with things the experimenter did not set on purpose: how crowded the microscope field of view was, how many parasites landed in it, how large the host cell is, how bright the parasite marker is (spectral spill-over into the readout channel), where on the laboratory microplate the microplate sample position sits. When such a variable differs between the conditions being compared *and* moves the readout inside a condition, it confounds the comparison.
records.label: spacr.recruitment_confounders#1
records.source: A recruitment ratio (or a vacuole size) measured per object is not only a function of the condition in the well. It also moves with things the experimenter did not set on purpose: how crowded the field was, how many parasites landed in it, how large the host cell is, how bright the parasite marker is (spectral spill-over into the readout channel), where on the plate the well sits. When such a variable differs between the conditions being compared *and* moves the readout inside a condition, it confounds the comparison.
records.translation: 按对象测得的募集比率（或液泡大小）并不仅仅是孔中条件的函数。它还会随实验者并非有意设定的因素而变化：视野有多拥挤、其中落入了多少寄生虫、宿主细胞有多大、寄生虫标记物有多亮（光谱串扰进入读出通道）、孔位于板上的什么位置。当这样一个变量在被比较的条件之间存在差异，*并且*在同一条件内使读出值发生变化时，它就会混杂这一比较。

records.context: This module does three things, in the order an analysis needs them:
records.label: spacr.recruitment_confounders#2
records.source: This module does three things, in the order an analysis needs them:
records.translation: 本模块按分析所需的顺序完成三件事：

records.context: ``field_density`` / ``flag_crowded_fields`` Count host cells and parasites per imaged microscope field of view straight from ``measurements.db`` and flag microscope fields of view that are crowded beyond a robust (median + k·MAD) limit, have too few host cells to be informative, or carry too many parasites per host cell. Over-infected microscope fields of view are where vacuoles fuse, masks merge and host cells lyse, so they are excluded, not adjusted.
records.label: spacr.recruitment_confounders#3
records.source: ``field_density`` / ``flag_crowded_fields`` Count host cells and parasites per imaged field straight from ``measurements.db`` and flag fields that are crowded beyond a robust (median + k·MAD) limit, have too few host cells to be informative, or carry too many parasites per host cell. Over-infected fields are where vacuoles fuse, masks merge and host cells lyse, so they are excluded, not adjusted.
records.translation: ``field_density`` / ``flag_crowded_fields`` 直接从 ``measurements.db`` 统计每个成像视野中的宿主细胞和寄生虫数量，并标记以下视野：拥挤程度超过稳健（median + k·MAD）上限的视野、宿主细胞过少而无法提供信息的视野，或每个宿主细胞中寄生虫过多的视野。过度感染的视野中液泡会融合、掩膜会合并、宿主细胞会裂解，因此这些视野被排除，而不是被校正。

records.context: ``confounder_report`` For each candidate covariate: its within-condition slope on the outcome (condition fixed effects, so a difference *between* conditions is not mistaken for a slope), and how unevenly it is distributed across conditions (eta squared). A covariate is a likely confounder when both are non-trivial.
records.label: spacr.recruitment_confounders#4
records.source: ``confounder_report`` For each candidate covariate: its within-condition slope on the outcome (condition fixed effects, so a difference *between* conditions is not mistaken for a slope), and how unevenly it is distributed across conditions (eta squared). A covariate is a likely confounder when both are non-trivial.
records.translation: ``confounder_report`` 对每个候选协变量给出：它在条件内对结果变量的斜率（采用条件固定效应，因此不会把条件*之间*的差异误认为斜率），以及它在各条件间分布的不均衡程度（eta squared）。当两者都不可忽略时，该协变量很可能是混杂因素。

records.context: ``adjust_for_covariates`` ANCOVA-style adjustment with a pooled within-condition slope: ``y = alpha_condition + sum_k beta_k * z_k``, where ``z_k`` are the covariates standardised over all rows. The adjusted value is ``y - sum_k beta_k * z_k``, i.e. every object is moved to the grand mean of every covariate. Because the slopes are estimated within conditions, the adjustment cannot absorb a true condition effect into a covariate; it only removes the part of the difference explained by covariate imbalance.
records.label: spacr.recruitment_confounders#5
records.source: ``adjust_for_covariates`` ANCOVA-style adjustment with a pooled within-condition slope: ``y = alpha_condition + sum_k beta_k * z_k``, where ``z_k`` are the covariates standardised over all rows. The adjusted value is ``y - sum_k beta_k * z_k``, i.e. every object is moved to the grand mean of every covariate. Because the slopes are estimated within conditions, the adjustment cannot absorb a true condition effect into a covariate; it only removes the part of the difference explained by covariate imbalance.
records.translation: ``adjust_for_covariates`` 采用合并条件内斜率的 ANCOVA 式校正：``y = alpha_condition + sum_k beta_k * z_k``，其中 ``z_k`` 是在所有行上标准化后的协变量。校正值为 ``y - sum_k beta_k * z_k``，即把每个对象移到每个协变量的总均值处。由于斜率是在条件内估计的，校正不会把真实的条件效应吸收到协变量中；它只去除差异中由协变量不平衡所解释的部分。

records.context: Only adjust for variables the condition does not itself cause. A variable on the causal path (a mediator) - for example vacuole size when the question is whether a mutant grows slower - is removed together with the effect it carries. ``confounder_report`` cannot tell the two apart; that decision belongs to the experimenter.
records.label: spacr.recruitment_confounders#6
records.source: Only adjust for variables the condition does not itself cause. A variable on the causal path (a mediator) - for example vacuole size when the question is whether a mutant grows slower - is removed together with the effect it carries. ``confounder_report`` cannot tell the two apart; that decision belongs to the experimenter.
records.translation: 只应针对不由条件本身引起的变量进行校正。位于因果路径上的变量（中介变量）——例如当问题是某突变体是否生长更慢时的液泡大小——会连同它所承载的效应一起被去除。``confounder_report`` 无法区分这两者；这一判断属于实验者。

records.context: Remove the covariate-explained part of ``outcome`` (pooled within-group ANCOVA).

records.context: Fits ``outcome ~ group + z_1 + ... + z_k`` jointly, with every covariate standardised over all rows, and returns ``adjusted = outcome - sum_k beta_k * z_k`` (on the log scale when ``log_outcome``, back-transformed afterwards). Each row is thereby moved to the grand mean of every covariate; the condition means of the adjusted column are the ANCOVA adjusted means.
records.label: spacr.recruitment_confounders.adjust_for_covariates#1
records.source: Fits ``outcome ~ group + z_1 + ... + z_k`` jointly, with every covariate standardised over all rows, and returns ``adjusted = outcome - sum_k beta_k * z_k`` (on the log scale when ``log_outcome``, back-transformed afterwards). Each row is thereby moved to the grand mean of every covariate; the condition means of the adjusted column are the ANCOVA adjusted means.
records.translation: 在所有协变量均于全部行上标准化的情况下联合拟合 ``outcome ~ group + z_1 + ... + z_k``，并返回 ``adjusted = outcome - sum_k beta_k * z_k``（当 ``log_outcome`` 时在 log 尺度上计算，之后再反变换）。由此每一行都被移到每个协变量的总均值处；校正后列的各条件均值即为 ANCOVA 校正均值。

records.context: A microscope field of view fails when any of ``columns`` exceeds ``median + mad_threshold * MAD`` (computed per ``by`` group, i.e. per laboratory microplate), when it has fewer than ``min_cells`` host cells, or when its parasites-per-cell exceeds ``max_pathogens_per_cell``.
